target_fidelity.note: It is an active, positive past-tense polar question with no modal or aspect.

grammaticality.note: The target answer is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The prompt and question form a coherent, natural exchange.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice of past simple question formation with did.

determinacy.note: The prompt also naturally permits “Did Mia use the bus yesterday?”, which is not listed as accepted.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: “Bus,” “yesterday,” and the context are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt does not display the completed target question.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Solving it requires only basic past-question formation and simple vocabulary.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external factual or specialist knowledge is needed.
